run_libri_labels_extract: run the script to extract word and letter transcriptions from a LibriSpeech TSV file into .wrd and .ltr output files
run_libri_labels_cli: run the CLI tool with a TSV input path, output directory, and output name to generate transcription files for wav2vec datasets
create_transcription_files: create .wrd and .ltr transcription files from a LibriSpeech TSV by parsing directory-based .trans.txt files and writing word and letter-level outputs
parse_librispeech_transcriptions: parse LibriSpeech .trans.txt files from a TSV list of audio paths and cache transcriptions per directory to avoid redundant file reads
generate_letter_transcriptions: generate letter-level transcription output by replacing spaces with pipe characters and joining characters with spaces for wav2vec letter-level training
